lines: Treasury yields have been the dominant driver overnight, spiking enough to pressure futures before easing into the morning, so intraday yield moves remain the key risk factor for index futures direction [f027a442d9] [d21eeb08f3] [a4718f08a7] [986f6c1a93] [56aa0a6761] [b00c1c12fe].

Fed policy uncertainty is in focus given expectations the central bank may need to take a firmer stance on inflation amid the yield surge, adding a macro overhang for rate-sensitive tech names [e1b2d96aae].
AI-driven tech optimism is offsetting some inflation-fear pressure on futures, keeping mega-cap tech a key swing factor for the Nasdaq leg [c62463baec] [3579881f08].

Dollar positioning is shifting as rising yields and Fed hike bets have prompted Morgan Stanley to reverse its bearish dollar call, with the dollar also tracking toward weekly gains — relevant for cross-asset flows into equity futures [62bd19ec68] [c6e4380139].
